p.i: cessores sibi designare: hosq; cognoscendi judicandiq; potestatem habuisse de negotiis & querelis omnibus omnium hospitum ac peregrinorum Dammonam venientium, sine contradictione: similiter de contractibus quibusvis coram ipsis judicibus initis, de promissionibus itidem apud eos factis, decisa æstimationis parte quarta; præterea de damnis pecudum vi Dammonensi à Dammonensi illatis: at de membrorum mutilatione & de vulneribus judicium eorum non fuisse, nisi facinus patratum esset ipsis præsentibus, aut incendii tempore: Et tamen in eo quoq; casu Consulis, id est, judicis superioris, quem Redgerum dicere mos est, multam ex lega-

fuisse, non secus ac si ipse judicasset: eosdem judices illos ter quotannis judicia exercuisse per dies quinos: ter item pondera & mensuras examinasse: panis quoq; venalis, cerevi-sia, vini, viarum, puteorum, & similium rationem & curam habuisse, (quod ædilium annonæ præfectorum solet munus esse:) litem introductam ad horum tribunal, si lis hujusce tribunalis esset, non licuisse litigantibus, judicibus his despectis, alio traducere: si quis contra fecisset, seu actor

page.notes: Running head is set in italic with the word "Groninga" followed by a colon as printed. The page is set in roman with the body in italic type throughout. The marginal note "Redger." is set in heavy type and is taken as a marginal note. The catchword "actor" and signature "B 2" are at the foot. The reading "cerevi-sia" and "lega-" are line-end hyphenations as printed; the sense of "lega-" is not fully resolved from the scan. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
